2026 1.title: The Evening Mallard (Logo)
text: Used a pen tablet (those little slabs of plastic you plug into a computer) and Krita to make this one.
I first photoshopped a picture of a Mallard until it looked kinda like this, then I copied it and then drew a top hat on top.
Used pixlr to photoshop the duck, then to arrange the logo text.
